Does "LEAK_SENSOR" mean ... water leakage or electron leakage?  I'm surprised to see water leakage as a MAX1363 chip.
This is based on the HPM schematic(602-24476-0201-A01.pdf), pages 231 and 232, as referenced in the document (ID:1126547) on NVONLINE.
Literally speaking, it seems to be detecting water leakage — that's my guess.
Acknowledged

@alex.ts.wang@fii-foxconn.com - Please squash the next two commits together if that is appropriate.  You added this file here and then in the very next commit deleted it.  Also, this commit fails compile.
Done

To my (not-an-expert) eyes, the additions appear to make sense, and it's passing tests now, so I'll +1

I have the impression the commits called out by Patrick have *not* yet been squashed yet -- am I reading the Gerrit commit history correctly?
Is there a reason these comments are randomly sprinkled through out?  It isn't clear to me how these are related to the code.
These comments were just for internal debugging. I have removed all of them.
Done
I suspect these bus-identifiers also do not work.  These end up being BMC bus numbers and not bus numbers relative to the FRU.  Doesn't this make the whole file specific to the Clemente DC-SCM?
Done
This will not work.  Both the GB200 and GB300 have the same "BOARD_PRODUCT_NAME" identifier?
Done

I'm confused by all the fan sensors being listed here.  Aren't there 2 GB300 boards?  We don't have all the fans connected to both of them, do we?  Why are the fans connected to the CPU boards anyhow?  Shouldn't they be off the PDB?

There are two Bianca GB300 boards. NV QS design moved out FAN board and connected FAN on HPM(CPU board) directly.
Please refer to NVOnline (ID: 1126424). The schematic is available there, and you can find the fan controller located on the HPM.
Done
Adding bus numbers here does not seem appropriate.
Done
There are two Bianca boards on the GB300. BUS 12 represents the first one.
Done
There are two Bianca boards on the GB300. BUS 13 represents the second one.

It is still unexpected to me that we have hard-coded bus here for some of the sensors.  Since there are 2 GB300 cards in the server, won't we end up with the same sensors defined twice, with the same bus / address?
The version using variables has already been uploaded.
